scene: You enter an overgrown chamber where bioluminescent mushrooms illuminate ancient hydroponic tanks.
picture: Side-view pixel art along one ground line. On the far left, bright blue mushrooms sprout across damp stone. To the left stands the grandfather in his navy apron, pushing his bicycle of potted plants. In the centre, a bubbling glass hydroponic tank glows green. On the far right, a wrought-iron spiral staircase winds upward.
